name: QWEN-EFFORT-0
note: Machine-readable form of PRE-REG QWEN-EFFORT-0; the prose governs on any conflict. Study A of Artin's GO QWEN-EFFORT-AND-DEEPCHAT-0 (2026-10-23): the frozen 46-task v2 battery (prompts, validators, greedy decoding, context cap unchanged; the amended thinking scorer of QWEN-THINKING-BATTERY-0-RULES) under two NEW execution configurations, enable_thinking True with the pinned template's reasoning_effort low and medium at 768 tokens, one pass each, against the historical controls (no thinking 384; thinking xhigh 768). The battery has been exposed to model-selection research (two thinking configurations already read) and is not an independent holdout. Decision rule: an arm qualifies for a RECOMMENDED default change (no flip in this round) only when all five of its bars read FIRE; bars are reported individually; no composite score selects an arm. All conclusions are conditional on greedy decoding (the vendor recommends sampling for ordinary generation; sampling is deliberately not used, for comparability).

BASELINE.description: historical control: logs/qwen_battery/results_v2.json, enable_thinking False, 384 tokens (33 of 46; arithmetic plus JSON 8 of 18; code 7 of 8; other 18 of 20; 2,240 tokens; 419 s)

XHIGH768.description: historical control: logs/qwen_battery/results_v2_think768.json, enable_thinking True, effort xhigh (the template default), 768 tokens (36 of 46; 16 of 18; 2 of 8; 18 of 20; 8 unterminated turns; 14,721 tokens; 1,792 s)

LOW.description: enable_thinking True, reasoning_effort low (the template injects its brief-reasoning system instruction), 768 tokens, a fresh replay session per task, one pass

MEDIUM.description: enable_thinking True, reasoning_effort medium (the template injects no reasoning instruction; the think block opens as with xhigh), 768 tokens, one pass

bars.name: ARITH-JSON-LOW
bars.description: arithmetic plus JSON at least 14 of 18 under low (one-run fence: 13 and 14 unresolved).

bars.name: CODE-LOW
bars.description: code at least 6 of 8 under low (5 and 6 unresolved).

bars.name: OTHER-LOW
bars.description: instruction, two-turn and termination together at least 17 of 20 under low, no meaningful regression from the controls' 18 (16 and 17 unresolved).

bars.name: TERMINATION-LOW
bars.description: at most 4 of 52 turns with an unclosed think block under low, substantially fewer than xhigh's 8 (4 and 5 unresolved).

bars.name: COST-LOW
bars.description: generated tokens under low at most 0.6 of xhigh's 14,721 (8,832) and task time at most 0.6 of xhigh's 1,792 s (1,075 s): a clearly reduced cost.

operands.name: the validators and the amended thinking scorer
the engine with the reasoning_effort routing

refuted_if: The practical objective (strong arithmetic and JSON WITHOUT losing most of the code performance, at a termination and cost clearly better than xhigh) is NULL for this round if neither arm reads FIRE on all five of its bars; the configurable behaviour is retained and no default change is recommended. Bar 1 NO-FIRE (fewer than 13 of 18 under low) reads as low sacrificing arithmetic accuracy; bar 2 NO-FIRE (4 or fewer of 8) as low not recovering code.
registered_prior: The low instruction asks for brief thinking; under greedy decoding the model followed the xhigh instruction into 8 unterminated blocks of 52 at 768 tokens (6 of them code), so low is expected to close more blocks (2 to 5 unterminated), recover part of code (4 to 6 of 8) and give back part of the arithmetic and JSON recovery (12 to 15 of 18), at roughly half the tokens (6,000 to 9,000) and time; medium (no instruction) is expected between low and xhigh on every count (unterminated 4 to 7, code 2 to 5, arithmetic and JSON 14 to 16, tokens 9,000 to 13,000). Expected outcome: neither arm fires all five bars; the likeliest full pass is low failing bar 1 or bar 2 at the fence. The instruction kinds are expected unchanged (17 to 19 of 20). First-token latency: low near xhigh (a system message of similar length), medium below both (no system message).
